title: Kiritani Haruka — Cheeky Junior!〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: MORE MORE HOUSE - Practice Room

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're starting to rush, Airi.
You need to maintain a steady pace while performing slow squats.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay...!
*Wince*

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Your posture's falling apart.
Shift your weight a little further back... No, that's too far!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, do your last ten while maintaining that posture. I'll do them with you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Forty-eight, forty-nine, fifty...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I'm exhausted...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Nice work, Airi...
You got through all three sets.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Th-Those last squats were killing me!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is meant to be a hard training session. I know it's tough, but this method does work.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, if you say so...
Anyway, I'm glad I was able to get through all three sets...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I am impressed by how much you've improved in such a short period of time.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But you're doing these kinds of exercises all the time, right...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah, I follow a similar training regimen.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, I shouldn't be resting!
I'm gonna figure out a way to make this a part of my routine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, I'd like to...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But my legs are feeling really sore...
Mind if we take a break before starting back up again?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you want to take a break now?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I still feel totally fresh.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
But if you really need it, you go ahead and take a break, Airi.
I'll continue without you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Y-You...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Fine, you're on!
Be it five or ten sets, let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's just do one extra set.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, sounds good!
Ready... Go!!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Phew...
Alright, now we can actually take a break.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah... Okay...
I'm definitely at my limit...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But the way you got through that extra set after doing three was remarkable. Well done, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
You're doing it again...
Trying to get me all fired up, are you?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
I guess you've always been this cheeky!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I haven't forgotten about when we ran into each other on the rooftop after you'd quit being an idol!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The rooftop...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, that time...?
Yeah, now that you mention it, things did get a little tense.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
To be fair, it was sorta my fault...
We were both going through a lot of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Back then, I never would've imagined myself becoming an idol again, let alone forming a group with you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Same here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know we didn't get off on the right foot back then, but I have a huge amount of respect for you now.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're a professional with a calm and careful demeanor, which has been enormously helpful.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I also think you've been big for us, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Because you're always there to pull us in the right direction whenever we're not sure what to do.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: When we were looking for an agency, and during our summer training camp... You helped us make all the right decisions.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Every time we've found ourselves in a tough situation or felt like we were sinking, you took a hard look at things and found ways to keep us afloat.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, I think we both need each other.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Anyway, I think we've rested for long enough. Shall we resume...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, sounds good.
We've still got a bunch of exercises left to do today...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I feel even more motivated now because of you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Likewise.
But don't suddenly run out of gas on me again, okay?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There you go again...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, let's get started.
